pages.text: This page is the shortest practical route into Calculator. It intentionally avoids a giant shopping list because recipes, power costs and research requirements can be changed by the server or pack.$p1. Craft the Calculator using the live recipe below. Keep the Field Guide nearby: the same item can always bring you back to these instructions.$p2. Make or connect a basic power source. The Hand-Cranked Generator is the built-in early option; an external FE source also works when its route is enabled.$p3. Place a Power Cube if you want a visible energy buffer between generation and machines. Set its sides so energy enters from the source and exits toward the machine.$p4. Craft an Extraction Chamber. Feed it a valid early input such as the recipe list shows, supply the full batch energy, and leave output space.$p5. When you get Dirty or Damaged circuit material, do not put it directly into Analysis. Restore Dirty chips, Reassemble Damaged chips, then Analyse clean boards.$p6. Build a Research Chamber when a recipe says it is locked. Study the required sample; the guide can show your current research snapshot but reading the page does not unlock it.$p7. After one manual batch works, configure item sides and automation. Test one connection at a time before adding Transfer Upgrades or a large pipe network.$pCraft the Calculator: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.
